brief.topic: Allah looks at hearts and deeds
brief.audience: Muslims looking for a short, authentic reminder they can act on today

coreInsight: A hadith in Sahih Muslim and an ayah in Ash-Shu'ara together point to the heart, not appearance or wealth.

hooks.text: Does it matter how it looks?
hooks.notes: Clear in two seconds; the source answers it right away.

hooks.text: Your heart is being looked at.

hooks.notes: Works better as a takeaway line.

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the quoted source pays it off immediately.

body: Sahih Muslim 2564c and Qur'an 26:88-89, read together: faces and wealth are not what is looked at — the heart and its deeds are.
A question to sit with today: what does my heart need?
